name: CROWN INNOVATION
address: 347 SE LOGSDEN STREET STE 100, BEND, OR 97702

fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the street in both directions.
• Mark the entrance to any secondary access point with a matching reflective address marker so responders can confirm they are at the correct property.
• Keep the detached structure clearly identified with a visible label or marker so arriving responders can quickly distinguish it from the main residence.
• Clear the storage area of any items that block foot passage around the detached structure.
• Keep a clear walking path between the main residence and the detached structure at all times.
• Mark or identify the rear access point so responders approaching from the front can locate it without searching.
• Keep the rear access point unlocked or provide a method for responders to open it without assistance.
• Remove any vehicles or stored items from the access drive that would prevent a fire apparatus or ambulance from reaching the detached structure.
• Keep the open lawn area free of stored equipment or debris that would block responder movement or equipment staging.
• Confirm that the access drive surface can support the weight of a fire apparatus and communicate any weight restrictions to your local fire station in advance.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Mow or cut the tall grass areas down before dry season to reduce the amount of dry material that can carry fire toward the structures.
• Thin trees within the identified tree cluster to create open space between individual trees and slow fire movement through the group.
• Keep grass cover around structures cut short, particularly in areas closest to the buildings.
• Trim low-hanging branches on scattered trees near structures to reduce the chance of fire climbing from the ground into the tree canopy.
• Remove any dead grass or dry plant buildup that accumulates along the edges of open green space where it meets structures or outbuildings.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging branches and low vegetation so emergency vehicles can move through without obstruction.
• Maintain open lanes along driveways by trimming back any shrubs or grass that encroaches on the travel surface or reduces clearance height.
• Separate any wood piles, equipment, or stored materials from the tree cluster edges to reduce flammable material near grouped trees.
